changes.rationale: Against the SHIPPED baseline (mixed), confirmed_correct. The recovered completed December 13, 2022 Samah Abdelrahim report explicitly says the study partially replicated and specifies agreement in overall shape generalization alongside greater item variation and a nonsignificant random-effects comparison. This author-overall verdict supports mixed under rule 1; it is neither an inferred conversion of the collection's ordinal ratings nor a verdict derived from p=0.318 alone. The final Rmd independently contains the same substantive verdict; the unfinished copy has template prompts instead and does not override it. Positive binding is sufficient for this categorical outcome: the collection names project jara-ettinger2022 in cohort 2022-2023, target Experiment 5 of the same fully cited original, US online participants, one between-person trial, and a shape-match claim; the archived psych251/jara-ettinger2022 repository identifies Samah Abdelrahim, was created in October 2022 and last pushed in February 2023, and supplies this final report and Rmd with the same task, original N144 and target Experiment 5. Chen's later rescue explicitly summarizes the first attempt and names Abdelrahim (2022) with N142 and the matching estimate 1.13790, p=.318 and SE1.14030. These jointly bind the primary report to the current project beyond filename or publication year. The report states N142 whereas the collection records N147 and 91 shape choices; the reason is unknown and no count, exclusion or numerical reconciliation is inferred. Project-level binding is sufficient for the author verdict, not proof of identical analytic samples or an endorsement of the collection's numeric extraction. The complete current main report and SI supply no categorical original-specific verdict contradicting this report: 0.5 instructor, 0.75 report and 0.5 adjudicated are retained as ordinal judgments without recoding them as categories. The original-specific prior 25-row review's missing-report objection is now resolved by actual completed primary evidence. The shipped quotation describes Chen's later rescue, not Abdelrahim's first attempt; replace its evidence provenance with the recovered 2022 overall verdict when integrating, while retaining the mixed category. The rescue is supporting chain context only and is not coded or added as a collection record. No missing original blocks this author-verdict decision: the report states its target, original claim and specific comparisons; no DOI is invented from the primary report, which has no reference list or printed DOI.
